quests.title: An Honest Promotion

dialogue.t: Y'know, {NICKNAME}, Paimon can see that the commissions have been pretty taxing lately.
As a thoughtful, capable guide, Paimon's duty is to help you relax, so... Ta-da! Guess where this is?

dialogue.sit: Well, it says "Damoville Purveyor" on the sign right here.
Ah, the abode of Mora thieves, the graveyard of wallets.

dialogue.t: Hello there. Welcome to Damoville Purveyor.
This is no ordinary store. This is a place where hardworking laborers relax via spending money.
Indeed, indeed! In fact, we have recently launched a buy one get one free promotion, with all customers welcome to take part!
My loss if you buy, your loss if you don't!
Hehe, Paimon saw the event poster when we passed by before. That's how she remembered it.
Double the goods for every purchase sounds like a great deal, no matter how you slice it!
It always feels like there's something missing in Paimon's day if she doesn't spend some Mora here... So today, we're coming here together to fill that gap!

dialogue.sit: And what would you like to buy, Paimon?
And how shall this yawning void be filled, Paimon?

dialogue.t: Hehe, not telling you just yet.

dialogue.sit: Payment might get tricky that way.

dialogue.t: Nah, don't worry. Paimon brought her own Mora today.
Boss, has the order arrived yet? It's under "Paimon and {NICKNAME}."
We do have your package. One moment...

dialogue.sit: Boucicaut the shopkeeper retrieves something over-packaged beyond identification. Beside you, Paimon fishes out a large pile of pocket money. You detect a hint of sadness on her face as she parts with this sizable sum.
After you unwrap the package together, you realize that it contains two photo albums.

quests.description: “Buy one get one free! My loss if you buy, your loss if you don’t!”But what sort of gullible folk would be taken in by such slogans… Wait, Paimon pre-ordered already?
